videos.title: My slightly weird hobby...
videos.description:
When I started making videos alongside studying medicine and working as a doctor, most people saw it as a slightly weird hobby.

And to be fair, from the outside, it probably looked like I just talked to a camera occasionally.

But behind each video was scripting, filming, editing, negotiating, analysing data, building products and answering messages. Eventually, that weird side hustle became a proper team and business.

Being a creator means being part creative, part marketer, part salesperson
